hero.subtitle: My journey began with a personal experience of losing 27kg, and today I'm here to help you reach your goals using the best scientific and psychological methods.

about.title: From Experience to Science:
about.intro: I'm Batoul.. Before becoming your coach, I was once in your shoes. My journey started with excess weight and emotional exhaustion, but at a moment of honesty with myself, I made the decision.
credentials: Clinical Nutrition Diploma from the American Institute.
Master's in Therapeutic Nutrition for Chronic Diseases — deep understanding of the body.
Certified Life Coach for training women on psychological transformation.
Practical training at SuperHuman Clinics and regular conference attendance.
about.quote: My goal isn't just to help you lose weight.. My goal is for you to find yourself, love your body, and learn how to live a healthy life forever.
about.weightLossLabel: Documented loss backed by science and experience

plans.sectionSubtitle: Not a temporary diet... but a real journey

plan1.name: First Step
plan1.description: A one-month subscription program for weight loss in a structured and practical way.
benefits: Personal call to assess your health and nutritional status.
Custom diet plan based on your goals and lifestyle.
Fitness plan suited to your physical level.
Plan updates every 10 days for optimal progress.
plan1.tagline: A real start... with steady steps and measured results.

plan2.name: Serious Change
plan2.description: An intensive 3-month package for a clear transformation in weight and lifestyle.
benefits: Detailed call to assess your health and set precise goals.
Custom diet plan tailored to your body type and lifestyle.
Practical fitness plan suitable for your level.
Plan updates every 15 days to maintain motivation and accelerate results.
plan2.tagline: Change doesn't happen by accident... it takes a clear plan and real commitment.

plan3.name: The Journey
plan3.description: A comprehensive annual package for building a lasting healthy lifestyle.
benefits: Monthly call for follow-up, progress evaluation, and course correction.
Custom and evolving diet plan based on your phase and progress.
Plan renewal every 15 days to maintain motivation and prevent plateaus.
Special Ramadan plan considering fasting and meal organization.
Continuous support to ensure lasting results throughout the year.
plan3.tagline: Not a temporary diet... but a real transformation journey lasting a full year.

certs.title: Internationally Accredited Certificates
certs.subtitle: I continuously develop myself to always give you the best

mission.quote: My message to you: It's not about dieting, it's about living
mission.description: I'm here to change the idea we all have about dieting. Dieting is not a punishment, nor is it a temporary period of deprivation that we finish and go back to our old habits. My goal is to help you build a healthy lifestyle that lasts a lifetime.

pillars.title: Home cooking is the foundation
pillars.desc: You can eat from the same home cooking you make for your family, with simple and smart adjustments to make it healthy and nutritious.

pillars.title: No deprivation
pillars.desc: Food is a pleasure, and it's impossible to stay consistent if we deprive ourselves. The secret is moderation, not restriction.

pillars.title: Realistic and flexible
pillars.desc: I know that life has gatherings, work, and pressures. The plan is tailored to fit your life.

pillars.title: Behavior change, not just weight
pillars.desc: We're working to modify our habits from the roots, so the healthy choice becomes the easiest choice.

results.title: Real Results
results.subtitle: Here we see the fruits of hard work and commitment. Real photos of trainees who changed their lives for the better.

testimonials.title: What They Say
testimonials.featured: I wanted to lose just 5 kg and it was sooo hard to commit and lose them — but with Batoula nothing is impossible. Two months of flexibility, awareness, and a comfortable system without deprivation.

items.name: A dedicated trainee
items.quote: Her effort is amazing, may God bless her — she's talented, loves the journey, enjoys it, knows what's best for her, and keeps trying and persevering.

items.name: Journey companion
items.quote: 30 days of follow-up are enough to become friends. Thank God I gained more than 100 companions in the past two months, proud of the results and the girls' feedback.

items.q: How many kg can I lose per month?
items.a: 4 to 6 kg depending on weight, age, and health condition.

items.q: Is there a diet for pregnant women?
Is there a diet for breastfeeding mothers?
items.a: Yes, with a system that ensures your needs and your baby's needs.

items.q: Is the follow-up with Batoula personally?
items.a: Yes, directly with Batoula via WhatsApp.
Available both ways, based on your preference.
Once payment is made, booking and contact will happen within 12 hours.

footer.cta: Ready to start a new life?
